scope: Selected foundation dependencies, not a complete repository audit or proof score

claims.result: The Hamiltonian and its Hilbert space define the current substrate; separate target models are not outputs merely because their labels match.
claims.limitation: No physical observation map or three-dimensional spacetime has been derived from these declarations.
claims.next_decision: Test scoped local-operator and graph-locality prerequisites.

claims.model: Bounded interval-local operators on unrestricted Bose Fock space
assumptions: Contiguous proper support with at least two exterior sites
Explicit weak commutation on the finite occupation core
claims.result: A bounded operator with the stipulated interval support and full-core weak conservation is scalar; independent derivation and adversarial proof review agree.
claims.limitation: One-exterior reflection and disconnected opposite-site SWAP are counterexamples outside the support hypotheses. This is not a no-go for constrained, dressed or low-energy gauge physics.
claims.next_decision: First focused run passed 235 tests after independent source/test review; finish isolated demos and selected inherited-plus-new verification.

claims.model: Graph-site maps from source neighborhoods to ring cells
claims.result: A source ball maps into a ring ball of at most min(L,2*floor(K)*r+1) cells. Fiber multiplicity limits its preimages. Superlinear source growth obstructs uniformly bounded maps of this class.
claims.limitation: Bounded graph fibers are not implied by an abstract encoding in infinite-dimensional Bose sites; counting feasibility is not map existence.
claims.next_decision: First focused run passed 366 tests after independent source/test review; complete selected inherited-plus-new verification without treating finite controls as the theorem.

claims.model: Bose ring and separately supplied finite-group gauge target
assumptions: Explicit encoding and target electric/magnetic operators
claims.result: An algebraic regular-representation encoding does not by itself provide invariant gauge dynamics or microscopic Gauss constraints.
claims.limitation: The failed particular encoding is not an exclusion of every dressed or low-energy construction.
claims.next_decision: Require a constructive local operator/dynamics map before a derived-gauge claim.

claims.model: Legacy flavor relations and supplied sphere index
assumptions: Supplied charge and flux in sphere constructions
claims.result: The retained three-family input is not derived from topology. LEP constrains light neutrinos with the relevant Z coupling, not an exact universal count of all families.
claims.limitation: The registry's is_exact flag remains a legacy grading behavior, explicitly not scientific exactness. Numeric value and stored zero uncertainty are preserved.
claims.next_decision: Do not promote the input into a prediction; grading changes require a separate scoped repair.

claims.model: Phenomenological neutrino and quark flavor formulas
claims.result: Numerically specified relations are not a derived physical fermionic Hamiltonian or a complete independent parameter count.
claims.limitation: Only four registry statuses are reconciled in this tranche. Other mass, CKM and legacy GUE labels are retained, not newly endorsed.
claims.next_decision: Require physical operator maps and an independently selected source before predictive flavor claims.

claims.model: Supplied six-dimensional complex Weyl Spin(10) 16 with U(1)_X
assumptions: Specified local anomaly polynomial and sphere reduction
claims.result: The p2 coefficient is -s/90. Restricted reduction discards parent information; lower-dimensional cancellation does not establish consistency of this parent.
claims.limitation: An identical opposite-chirality partner cancels the polynomial but yields vectorlike reduction on the same background; a local polynomial check alone is not all global consistency.
claims.next_decision: No claim of this parent as a consistent common foundation without a separately approved completion.

claims.model: Externally supplied density, Peierls and local-energy sources
claims.result: Contact-completed Ward identities hold for the stipulated source family; alternative energy partitions and source-dependent identity terms prevent a unique metric-action inference.
claims.limitation: No dynamical metric, physical helicity-two pole or universal coupling follows from an external-source identity.
claims.next_decision: Require an explicit metric/source map and a dynamical common action.

assumptions: Specified bulk species and curvature coupling
claims.result: Effective coefficients do not uniquely identify bare, counterterm and cutoff contributions; a finite Hamiltonian offset is not covariant vacuum density.
claims.limitation: Internal/topological multiplicity is not automatically a count of four-dimensional bulk scalar fields. Legacy cosmology normalization inconsistencies remain unrepaired.
claims.next_decision: Consume these ambiguities in the common-foundation decision, without new fits.

assumptions: Frozen schedules, arithmetic and supplemental sign criterion
claims.result: The selected regression passed 4945 tests with 10 platform skips; the separate fixed supplemental acquisition failed four nonzero/sign assertions.
claims.limitation: Publication does not waive the failed criterion, certify numerical errors or erase the older one-ULP repeatability failure.
claims.next_decision: Preserve failure unchanged; any numerical revision is separately approved and versioned.

claims.model: Joint response ratio with factorized readout/source gains
assumptions: Same Hamiltonian, state, operators and noise map as conventional Bose alternative
claims.result: Identical model and observation distributions cannot be distinguished by a statistical test. Unrestricted independent additive backgrounds also eliminate response identifiability.
claims.limitation: Calibration and real data remain missing, but acquiring them alone would not break this model equivalence.
claims.next_decision: Require a separately derived distinguishing consequence before a BPR-discrimination data campaign.
